indicators.name: Exponential moving average
indicators.claim: The relative position of the fast, middle, and slow EMA describes directional alignment; a stack state is followed by a directional move more often than the base rate.
indicators.formula: seed = SMA(first n closes); alpha = 2/(n+1); ema_t = alpha*close_t + (1-alpha)*ema_(t-1)

indicators.name: Relative strength index
indicators.claim: RSI threshold crossings mark momentum shifts; the forward return after a crossing differs from the base rate.

indicators.name: Average true range
indicators.claim: ATR and ATR ratio describe volatility context; they do not predict direction.

indicators.name: Relative volume
indicators.claim: Fast and slow relative volume describe participation; an expansion or contraction is a context for a directional claim.

indicators.name: Moving Average Convergence Divergence
indicators.claim: MACD line/signal and histogram changes mark trend and momentum shifts; forward outcomes differ from the base rate.
indicators.formula: line = EMA(close,fast) - EMA(close,slow); signal = EMA(line,signal); histogram = line - signal
indicators.availability: slow bars for the line; slow+signal-1 for the signal

indicators.name: Confirmed swing pivots
indicators.claim: Confirmed pivots define price levels; a level test is followed by a path reaction more often than a matched barrier baseline.
indicators.formula: strict local extreme over k bars each side; confirmed at i+k

indicators.name: Volatility and participation regime
indicators.claim: ATR ratio and RVOL ratio define a regime; they condition other signals but do not predict direction alone.
indicators.formula: atr_ratio = ATR/SMA(ATR,20); rvol_ratio = volume/SMA(volume,20); bucket by 1.0 thresholds

indicators.name: Structural leg progression
indicators.claim: A leg's stage describes how far a move has travelled; target-hit-before-invalidation differs from the base rate.
indicators.formula: progress = (close-origin)/(target-origin); stage 0..5 from progress and lifecycle

indicators.name: Average Directional Index
indicators.claim: ADX measures trend strength; a high and rising ADX is a condition for trend continuation, not a directional signal by itself.

indicators.name: Directional Movement Index
indicators.claim: The sign and crossing of +DI and -DI describe directional movement; a DI cross is followed by a directional path more often than the base rate.

indicators.name: Volume-weighted average price
indicators.claim: A reclaim or rejection at the rolling VWAP reaches the ATR target before the stop more often than a matched barrier base.
indicators.formula: TP=(H+L+C)/3; VWAP=sum(TP*V,n)/sum(V,n); D=(C-VWAP)/ATR; S=VWAP-VWAP[n]; MAD=mean(abs(TP-VWAP),n); bands=VWAP +/- 2*MAD

indicators.name: Rolling volume profile
indicators.claim: A value-area breakout or POC cross reaches the ATR target before the stop more often than a matched barrier base.
indicators.formula: 96 bars, 24 price bins; bin_j=sum(V_i where TP_i in bin_j); POC=argmax(bin); VAH/VAL expand from POC until sum(bin)>=0.7*sum(V); PD=(C-POC)/ATR; VP=(C-VAL)/(VAH-VAL); SK=(V above POC - V below POC)/sum(V); CO=max(bin)/sum(V); PM=POC-POC[n]

indicators.name: Volume climax
indicators.claim: A high-volume wide-range bar marks a participation climax; the close location decides reversal or continuation.
indicators.formula: CL = RV5 >= 3 and range/ATR >= 1.5; CD=sign(C-O); CS=RV5*range/ATR

indicators.name: Absorption
indicators.claim: High volume with a small range at VWAP or POC marks absorption; the next bar's break or rejection is directional.
indicators.formula: AB = RV5 >= 2 and range/ATR <= 0.6 and min(|C-VWAP|,|C-POC|) <= 0.25 ATR; AS=RV5/(range/ATR)
indicators.availability: fast RVOL, VWAP or POC, and ATR available

indicators.name: Volume oscillator
indicators.claim: The fast/slow volume spread describes participation trend; it is context, not a standalone direction.

indicators.name: On-balance volume
indicators.claim: Cumulative signed volume describes flow; an OBV/MA cross or divergence is a flow claim.

indicators.name: Chaikin money flow
indicators.claim: Money-flow volume over the flow window describes accumulation or distribution.

indicators.name: Money flow index
indicators.claim: The volume-weighted RSI marks flow extremes and divergences.
indicators.formula: TP=(H+L+C)/3; POS=sum(TP*V where TP>TP_prev); NEG=sum(TP*V where TP<TP_prev); MFI=100-100/(1+POS/NEG)

indicators.name: Accumulation/distribution line
indicators.claim: The cumulative money-flow line describes accumulation or distribution.

indicators.name: ATR term structure
indicators.claim: The fast/slow ATR ratio describes the volatility regime.

indicators.name: Range expansion
indicators.claim: The current range relative to its mean describes expansion or contraction.

indicators.name: Mean absolute return
indicators.claim: The mean absolute return describes realized volatility.

indicators.name: Keltner channel
indicators.claim: The EMA plus/minus ATR band describes the volatility envelope.

indicators.name: Donchian channel
indicators.claim: The N-bar high/low channel describes range position and breakout state.

indicators.name: Swing structure
indicators.claim: Consecutive confirmed major pivots describe the structural state.
indicators.formula: HH=H[p]>H[p-1]; HL=L[p]>L[p-1]; SS=+1 if HH&&HL, -1 if LH&&LL, 0 otherwise
indicators.availability: two confirmed major pivots of each kind

indicators.name: Level strength
indicators.claim: The number of touches of a confirmed level describes its strength.
indicators.formula: T=count(confirmed major levels within 0.2ATR of H or L, lookback); age=bars since the youngest such level

indicators.name: Aroon
indicators.claim: The time since the N-bar high and low describes trend freshness.

indicators.name: Break of structure / change of character
indicators.claim: A close beyond the last confirmed pivot is a break of structure or a change of character.
indicators.formula: BOS: C>last_pivot_high in an up state; CHOCH: C>last_pivot_high in a down state; mirrors below

indicators.name: Candle anatomy
indicators.claim: Body, wick, and close-position ratios describe the bar's internal structure.
indicators.formula: R=H-L; B=|C-O|; UW=H-max(O,C); LW=min(O,C)-L; CP=(C-L)/R; BR=B/R; UWR=UW/R; LWR=LW/R

indicators.name: Candle pattern
indicators.claim: Engulfing, inside, outside, hammer, star, and three-bar patterns describe bar sequences.
indicators.formula: engulfing: C>O and O<=C_prev and C>=O_prev (mirror); inside: H<=H_prev and L>=L_prev; outside: H>H_prev and L<L_prev; hammer/star by wick and close position; three soldiers/crows by three rising/falling bars
indicators.availability: previous bar; three-bar patterns need three bars

indicators.name: Gap
indicators.claim: The open versus the prior close describes a gap and whether it filled.
indicators.formula: G=O-C_prev; GA=G/ATR; filled when |GA|>=0.5 and C crosses C_prev

indicators.name: Path efficiency
indicators.claim: The net move divided by the absolute path describes trend efficiency.

indicators.name: Direction changes
indicators.claim: The close-to-close direction-change ratio describes choppiness.

indicators.name: Bars since extreme
indicators.claim: The bars since the path-window high and low describe freshness.

indicators.name: Drawdown from high
indicators.claim: The close below the path-window high in ATR units describes drawdown.

indicators.name: Range position
indicators.claim: The close position inside the path-window range describes where price sits.

indicators.name: Relative strength
indicators.claim: The return difference against the peer basket describes relative positioning.
indicators.availability: common panel timestamps and return window

indicators.name: Lead-lag
indicators.claim: The leader's past return against the follower's current return describes flow propagation.

indicators.name: Breadth
indicators.claim: The share of instruments with a positive return describes participation breadth.

indicators.name: Co-movement
indicators.claim: The same-sign share against the basket describes co-movement.

indicators.name: Dispersion
indicators.claim: The cross-sectional return range describes dispersion.

indicators.name: Session state
indicators.claim: The session code and age describe the local session.
indicators.formula: local=UTC+zone offset; session_code=1 if start<=local_hour<end else 0; age=bars since session open

indicators.name: Opening range
indicators.claim: The first bars of a session define an opening range.
indicators.formula: ORH=max(H,first k bars); ORL=min(L,first k bars); ORR=(ORH-ORL)/ATR

indicators.name: Overnight/intraday
indicators.claim: The overnight return and the intraday return decompose the session move.

indicators.name: Session range
indicators.claim: The running session high-low in ATR describes the session range.

indicators.name: Calendar bucket
indicators.claim: The local day-of-week and month code describes the calendar bucket.

events.claim: A bar range intersects a confirmed or dynamic level; the touch is followed by a path reaction — the target is reached before the stop — more often than a matched barrier baseline.
events.formula: abs(C - L) <= test_atr * ATR, where L is the referenced EMA or confirmed pivot price

events.claim: A close crosses a level; the cross is followed by a path continuation — the target is reached before the stop — more often than a matched barrier baseline.

A close crosses a level and finishes beyond it; the break is followed by a path continuation — the continuation target is reached before the reversal stop — more often than a matched barrier baseline.
events.formula: (C[t] - L[t]) >= break_atr * ATR and (C[t-1] - L[t-1]) >= break_atr * ATR, or the mirror below

events.claim: A lower price low with a higher RSI low is followed by a reversal more often than the base rate.
events.formula: L[t] < L[p] and RSI[t] > RSI[p] at consecutive confirmed major pivots p

events.claim: A higher price high with a lower RSI high is followed by a reversal more often than the base rate.
events.formula: H[t] > H[p] and RSI[t] < RSI[p] at consecutive confirmed major pivots p

events.claim: A higher price low with a lower RSI low is followed by continuation more often than the base rate.
events.formula: L[t] > L[p] and RSI[t] < RSI[p] at consecutive confirmed major pivots p

events.claim: A lower price high with a higher RSI high is followed by continuation more often than the base rate.
events.formula: H[t] < H[p] and RSI[t] > RSI[p] at consecutive confirmed major pivots p

events.claim: An RSI threshold crossing is followed by a directional move more often than the base rate.
events.formula: cross_up(RSI, 30), cross_up(RSI, 50), cross_up(RSI, 70), or the mirror down

events.claim: A faster EMA crossing a slower EMA is followed by a directional move more often than the base rate.
events.formula: cross_up(EMA_fast, EMA_slow) or cross_down(EMA_fast, EMA_slow) for a configured pair

events.claim: An EMA stack state change is followed by a directional move more often than the base rate.
events.formula: sign(EMA_fast - EMA_mid) or sign(EMA_mid - EMA_slow) changes

events.claim: An RSI zone change is followed by a momentum shift more often than the base rate.
events.formula: zone(RSI) changes, where zone = -1 if RSI < 30, 0 if 30 <= RSI <= 70, +1 if RSI > 70

events.claim: The MACD line crossing its signal is followed by a directional move more often than the base rate.
A MACD histogram slope flip is followed by an acceleration or fade more often than the base rate.
The MACD line crossing zero is followed by a trend continuation more often than the base rate.
A DI crossover is followed by a path in the cross direction more often than a matched barrier baseline.
When ADX is at or above its threshold and rising, DI direction, the EMA stack, and the MACD state agree; the next path reaches +1 ATR before -1 ATR more often than the matched barrier baseline.
events.formula: ADX >= threshold and ADX[t] > ADX[t-slope] and DI side == EMA stack == MACD state == d

events.claim: A coiling context followed by a close beyond the compression range with RVOL confirmation predicts a larger forward range than coiling alone, not direction.
events.formula: range <= coiling_atr*ATR for N bars and C beyond the range by break_atr*ATR and RVOL >= min

events.claim: A completed coiling window publishes its high and low at the last coiling bar; the next bar touches at least one boundary more often than a matched non-coiling window completion. The event is neutral and does not claim direction.
events.formula: range <= coiling_atr*ATR for N consecutive bars

events.claim: The first completed coiling window after a known non-coiling bar publishes its high and low at the last coiling bar; the next bar touches at least one boundary more often than a matched non-coiling window completion. The event is neutral and does not claim direction.
events.formula: first bar of a new coiling window after a non-coiling bar

events.claim: A bar range that intersects the session VWAP marks a test of the volume-weighted price.
A close crossing the VWAP marks a change in side relative to the volume-weighted price.
A close that clears the VWAP by the break distance marks a break of the volume-weighted price.
A lower price low with a higher VWAP distance marks absorption.
A higher price high with a lower VWAP distance marks distribution.
A higher low with a lower VWAP distance marks hidden absorption.
A lower high with a higher VWAP distance marks hidden distribution.
A reclaim after six bars on the other side continues.
events.formula: cross_up(C,VWAP) and count(C < VWAP, 6) >= 6; mirror cross_down

events.claim: A rejection at VWAP reverses away from it.
events.formula: H >= VWAP and C < VWAP and C < O; mirror L <= VWAP and C > VWAP and C > O

events.claim: A change in the sign of the VWAP slope marks a turn in the volume-weighted price.
A close within the test band of the point of control marks a test of the profile POC.
A high within the test band of the value-area high marks a test of the VAH.
A low within the test band of the value-area low marks a test of the VAL.
A close beyond the value area after a close inside marks a value-area break.
events.formula: C > VAH or C < VAL after a close inside the value area

events.claim: A close back inside the value area after a close outside marks a value-area re-entry.
events.formula: C[t-1] > VAH and C[t] <= VAH, or the mirror below VAL

events.claim: A lower price low with a higher POC marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower POC marks distribution.
A value-area breakout with volume continues.
events.formula: (C > VAH or C < VAL) and RV20 >= 1.5

events.claim: A POC cross continues in the cross direction.
A change in the sign of profile skew marks a shift in volume above versus below the POC.
A cross of the profile concentration threshold marks a change in how concentrated volume is at the POC.
A lower price low with a higher slow RVOL marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower slow RVOL marks distribution.
A fast relative-volume expansion marks participation.
A fast relative-volume contraction marks fading participation.
A fast/slow RVOL ratio expansion marks a participation shift.
A lower price low with a higher climax volume marks exhaustion.
A higher price high with a lower climax volume marks fading demand.
A climax bar that closes back inside the prior range reverses.
events.formula: CL and C inside [L[t-1], H[t-1]]; direction -CD

events.claim: A climax bar that closes at its extreme continues.
events.formula: CL and CP >= 0.8 or CP <= 0.2; direction sign(C-O)

events.claim: A high-volume, narrow-range bar at the VWAP or POC marks absorption at that level.
events.formula: AB at VWAP or POC within 0.25 ATR

events.claim: A break of the absorption bar's range continues.
A rejection back inside the absorption range reverses.
events.formula: C inside the absorption bar's range; direction -AS_side

events.claim: A zero cross of the volume oscillator marks a change in fast versus slow volume.
A lower price low with a higher OBV marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower OBV marks distribution.
A higher low with a lower OBV marks hidden accumulation.
A lower high with a higher OBV marks hidden distribution.
An OBV/MA cross marks a flow shift.
A change in the sign of the OBV slope marks a change in cumulative volume flow.
A lower price low with a higher CMF marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower CMF marks distribution.
A higher low with a lower CMF marks hidden accumulation.
A lower high with a higher CMF marks hidden distribution.
A CMF zero cross marks a flow shift.
A cross of the Chaikin money-flow threshold marks a change in money-flow pressure.
A lower price low with a higher MFI marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower MFI marks distribution.
A higher low with a lower MFI marks hidden accumulation.
A lower high with a higher MFI marks hidden distribution.
An MFI threshold cross marks a flow shift.
A change in the MFI zone marks a move between oversold, neutral, and overbought money flow.
events.formula: zone(MFI) changes, zone = -1 below 20, 0 in 20..80, +1 above 80

events.claim: A lower price low with a higher A/D line marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower A/D line marks distribution.
An A/D line cross of its mean marks a flow shift.
A close within the test band of a Keltner band marks a test of that band.
A close beyond a Keltner band after a close inside marks a band break.
events.formula: C>U and C_prev<=U_prev, or C<L and C_prev>=L_prev

events.claim: A high or low within the test band of a Donchian boundary marks a test of that boundary.
A close beyond a Donchian boundary after a close inside marks a channel break.
events.formula: C>DH_prev and C_prev<=DH_prev, or C<DL_prev and C_prev>=DL_prev

events.claim: A close beyond the last confirmed pivot marks a break of the current structure.
events.formula: C>last_pivot_high and C_prev<=last_pivot_high, or C<last_pivot_low and C_prev>=last_pivot_low

events.claim: A confirmed level tested at least twice within the test band marks a stronger level.
A dominant wick that reaches a level marks a wick test of that level.
events.formula: upper_wick_ratio>=0.6 and abs(H-level)<=0.2ATR, or lower mirror

events.claim: A close that returns to the prior close marks a filled gap.
A gap within the test band marks a test of the prior close.
A lower price low with a higher ATR ratio marks volatility absorption.
A higher price high with a lower ATR ratio marks fading volatility.
A lower price low with a higher relative strength marks accumulation.
A higher price high with a lower relative strength marks distribution.
A lower price low with a higher lead-lag marks flow support.
A higher price high with a lower lead-lag marks fading flow.
A lower price low with higher breadth marks broad participation.
A higher price high with lower breadth marks narrowing participation.
A cross below the ATR-ratio threshold marks volatility compression.
A cross above the ATR-ratio threshold marks volatility expansion.
A change in the volatility-regime code marks a regime change.
A cross above the range-ratio threshold marks range expansion.
A cross below the range-ratio threshold marks range contraction.
none
A close outside a Keltner band marks a Keltner breakout.
events.formula: C>U and C_prev<=U_prev, or C<L and C_prev>=L_prev

events.claim: A cross of the Keltner position thresholds marks a move to the band edge.
A close outside a Donchian boundary marks a Donchian breakout.
events.formula: C>DH_prev and C_prev<=DH_prev, or C<DL_prev and C_prev>=DL_prev

events.claim: A cross of the Donchian position thresholds marks a move to the channel edge.
A change in the swing-structure code marks a structural change.
A cross of the level-touch count marks a change in level strength.
A cross of the Aroon thresholds marks a change in the recent-extreme balance.
A zero cross of the Aroon oscillator marks a change in the high/low recency balance.
A wide bar closing near its extreme marks candle momentum.
events.formula: range>=1.5ATR and BR>=0.7 and CP>=0.8 or CP<=0.2

events.claim: A dominant wick against the close marks candle rejection.
events.formula: UWR>=0.6 and C<O, or LWR>=0.6 and C>O

events.claim: A bar with a small body relative to its range marks indecision.
A bar with a body covering most of its range marks a marubozu.
A bar that engulfs the prior body marks an engulfing pattern.
A bar inside the prior range marks an inside pattern.
A bar outside the prior range marks an outside pattern.
A long lower wick with a small body near the high marks a hammer.
A long upper wick with a small body near the low marks a star.
Three rising closes mark three white soldiers.
Three falling closes mark three black crows.
A gap in the close direction marks gap continuation.
A gap against the close direction marks a faded gap.
none
none
A new high or low within the lookback marks a fresh extreme.
An extreme at the lookback edge marks a stale extreme.
A cross below the drawdown threshold marks a deeper drawdown.
A cross above the recovery threshold marks drawdown recovery.
A cross of the range-position thresholds marks a move to the range edge.
A relative-strength zero cross marks a change in positioning against the peer basket.
A leader-return threshold cross marks a propagation impulse.
A breadth threshold cross marks a change in participation breadth.
none
none
The first bar of a session marks the session open.
The last bar of a session is known only on the next bar.
events.formula: session_code[t]==0 and session_code[t-1]==1; occurred t-1, available t

events.claim: A close above the completed opening range marks a breakout.
A close below the completed opening range marks a fade.
A large overnight move continued by the first intraday bar marks continuation.
A large overnight move reversed by the first intraday bar marks a fade.
A session range crossing 1.5 ATR marks expansion.
A session range crossing below 0.7 ATR marks contraction.
A close beyond the last confirmed pivot in the direction of the current structure continues the structure.
events.formula: SS_prev>0 and C>last_pivot_high and C_prev<=last_pivot_high, or SS_prev<0 and C<last_pivot_low and C_prev>=last_pivot_low

events.claim: A close beyond the last confirmed pivot against the current structure changes character.
events.formula: SS_prev<0 and C>last_pivot_high and C_prev<=last_pivot_high, or SS_prev>0 and C<last_pivot_low and C_prev>=last_pivot_low

events.claim: A close at the session VWAP tests the session's volume-weighted price.
A bar range intersecting the opening-range high or low tests the range boundary.
events.formula: after k bars: abs(H-ORH)<=0.2*ATR or abs(L-ORL)<=0.2*ATR

events.claim: A close beyond the completed opening range breaks the range.
events.formula: after k bars: C>ORH and C_prev<=ORH_prev, or C<ORL and C_prev>=ORL_prev

events.claim: A sweep of the completed opening range that closes back inside predicts a reversal.
events.formula: after k bars: H>ORH+sweep*ATR and C<ORH -> -1, or L<ORL-sweep*ATR and C>ORL -> +1; if both sides sweep, the larger excursion wins and an exact tie emits no event

events.claim: A sweep of the completed opening range that closes outside is the continuation control for the reclaim event.
events.formula: after k bars: H>ORH+sweep*ATR and C>=ORH -> +1, or L<ORL-sweep*ATR and C<=ORL -> -1; the same larger-excursion tie-break applies
